annotation.title_clean: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI
annotation.title_en: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee (IEEE SA)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE EAD for Business Committee paper urging organizations to adopt expanded KPIs, such as ESG, UN SDG and IEEE 7010 well-being metrics, as success measures for responsible AI systems. It offers an Assess/Apply/Amplify framework and a readiness table for businesses. General AI only, with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Define 'responsible' at the outset and across the AIS life cycle using expanded KPIs
Adopt ESG, UN SDG and IEEE 7010 well-being metrics alongside financial metrics
Ignoring planetary and human well-being is the most significant AI risk, more than bias or opacity
Assess/Apply/Amplify framework with a Well-Being Metrics Readiness Framework table
Involve HR, legal, CSR, sustainability and supply chain in responsible AI metrics
